{{Quote|Patience! For the Jedi it is time to eat as well!|Yoda offering Luke Skywalker rootleaf stew|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Stew''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] enjoyed by many [[Species/Legends|species]], and came in equally diverse varieties. It often contained meat and [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]].
